purpose: Determine whether the q8 ONNX browser candidate can execute successfully at representative and boundary sequence lengths before any new frozen 500-pair browser parity experiment.

relationship_to_previous_experiment.previous_failure: RuntimeError: operation does not support unaligned accesses

synthetic_input_contract.base_query: What is the relation between being and knowledge?
synthetic_input_contract.base_document: Synthetic runtime feasibility document. This input exists only to exercise the browser runtime and is not part of any ranking evaluation.
synthetic_input_contract.construction: Tokenize the frozen prompt prefix, fixed synthetic content, and suffix using the pinned tokenizer. Assert filler_text encodes to exactly one token. Insert repeated filler token IDs between synthetic content and suffix until the exact preregistered total token count is reached.

requirements: exact preregistered token count is constructed
a finite raw yes-probability score in [0,1] is produced
primary_gate.pass_rule: All 3 of 3 cases must pass. A failure at any length fails the experiment.

failure_policy.after_failure: Freeze the result and preregister a new runtime candidate before further feasibility testing.

success_policy.next_step: If and only if all three synthetic cases pass, preregister a separate q8 500-pair browser parity experiment before accessing the frozen ranking holdout with q8.
